title: Metal pyrazolate frameworks: crystal engineering access to stable functional materials
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,3647-3680
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS00989D, Review Article
Xiang-Jing Kong, Guang-Rui Si, Tao He, Jian-Rong Li
This review depicts the full spectrum of metal pyrazaolate frameworks, highlighting their design principles, synthesis and structure, stability, and potential applications for addressing global challenges.
